_comment: Safari (macOS). Same permissions as Brave; the user still grants website access in Safari Settings > Extensions. Packaged by xcrun safari-web-extension-converter (see README). Never add background.scripts here: Safari prefers scripts over service_worker when both exist. Bundles are IIFE, so no type: module. Floor 18.4 per docs/COMPATIBILITY.md (fetch needs a permissions.request grant from 18.4; tabs.create pinned fixed in 18.3). tabs.move is unsupported and not used.
_comment_permissions: Arrays replace on merge: the base permissions plus nativeMessaging, which sends the diagnostics trace (core/diag.ts) to the app extension's os_log.
